scenario: Optional `as <expr>` on `after` for per-fact supersedure per LTAC.2.2.1. A new activation with the same evaluated key supersedes the prior timer. Pin: `after 5_min as r.entity_id:` compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: supersedure needs a run.
rules_ds:
schema Req scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule auto_cancel:
    Req r
->
    log info "trig"
    after 5_min as r.entity_id:
        log info "timed out"
